verdicts.line: [D4] scour: paused backward handed-off run continues forward | fixed 546d55225a
[D6] scour: taken-back run's row stays forever when its continuation is canceled or throws | fixed 92ed49e117

[D18] scour: handed-off run whose setter throws on end/cancel never cancels its browser animation | fixed 70c6a0e6e4 (the throw happens on cancel; a tween's end commits nothing, but the same guard now covers a coast's end commit)
[D5] scour: onDone throw in a taken-back continuation leaves the parent row | fixed cf64d67073
[D9] scour: a just-rested target's publish throw is swallowed with no log | fixed f1f8f4da7d
[D10] scour: compositor run never claims its target, so another animator takes it back before being refused | fixed d483ff9e88 (holds were refused the same way)

[D3] scour: paused backward animation at its end finishes forward at `to` | fixed 1282399010 (a scale of 0 now ends nothing except a tween of 0 ms or less, which matches how the timeline already treats a rate of 0)
[D17] timeline hold not released on `target.stop()` / row removal (scour): fixed 9aff74ee59

[D1] `cancel` with another animator's handle retires this animator's animation with the same id (scour): fixed b4ed075ab3. This needed a behavior call, which I made and recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `cancel(handle)` now calls `handle.cancel()`, so another animator's handle cancels in its own animator.
[D2] a throwing `onCancel` in `cancelAll` skips `cancelFrame`, and `dispose` stays undisposed (scour): fixed 1217af4f2d
[D15] `cancelAll` halts after its reports, dropping the frame an animation started from a report asked for (scour): fixed 1217af4f2d
[D8] a target whose `show` throws under a timeline hold logs every frame and is never stopped (scour): fixed 9aff74ee59
[D13] a release that throws leaves the hold on the table (scour): fixed be0b2d3de4
[D12] a throwing setter in `holdRows`' leave keeps the later rows held (scour): fixed e408cca94e

[D7] `follow` measures its first frame against a clock seeded from `host.now()` (scour): fixed d6c394873d. I also split `createAnimatorCore` for `check:size` (9d763d385b). Commits db32602c84 (a test type fix) and 5c5a852ac6 (changeset titles shortened) fix no defect.
[D14] Reading the clock between frames counted up to a frame twice (scour): fixed 9ee75de3d4
[D16] A coast started with `from` beside a hold started from the wrong place (scour): fixed a2ce4f3b9a

[D19] A spring played back to its start emitted its voice's reading instead of `from` (scour): not a defect (no longer applies). `startPhysics` now has one path, and every backward variant I tried ended exactly at `from`: after a retarget, through an outside clock, the handle's or the animator's `setTimeScale(-1)`, a start between frames, and a first backward frame past the start. The held↔free re-cue the finding describes happens only on target springs, which `startPhysics` does not run.
